title: Builders FirstSource Taps CFO Peter Jackson For Top Role As CEO Dave Rush Plans Retirement
description: Builders FirstSource has appointed Peter Jackson as its new CEO, succeeding the retiring Dave Rush. Pete Beckmann will take over as the new CFO. The company reported strong Q2 earnings and has a healthy liquidity position.

title: CDW Shares Dip As Q3 Sales Miss Amid Weak Hardware Demand And Customer Delays
description: CDW reported weaker-than-expected Q3 results, with revenue declining 2% year-over-year due to weak hardware demand and customer delays. The company's adjusted EPS of $2.63 missed the consensus estimate of $2.85.
